name: app-real-estate-portfolio-dashboard-on-3d-city-map
title: Investment property dashboard on a white 3D city model with lime-highlighted building
whatItIs: A pale tilted monitor showing a white 3D model of a neighbourhood with one building highlighted in translucent lime. Frosted panels carry property overview, holding stats, yield, a market value line chart and a payments table. Blurred detail crops of expenses bars and a documents list are shown below.
whatItMeans: Refined and tangible; the highlighted building ties abstract numbers to a physical asset.
techniques: Use a monochrome white 3D map with one lime-tinted focus object.
Place frosted panels over the map.
Show a thin line chart with a lime glow.
Add blurred zoomed crops to show detail.

vocabulary.definition: Colouring one object on a map.
An enlarged detail shown beside the full screen.
A map rendered in one neutral colour.
